label.explanation: msg-416639 at partition 10 offset 776449 contains bytes index-worker cannot parse. It is nacked and redelivered forever because no max-retries/DLQ is configured (lines 158, 159, 173, 174, 185, 186, 200, 201, 218, 219). That message blocks its partition, so lag grows (lines 187, 199, 216, 221, 234, 251, 257, 272, 279, 287, 295, 309) and downstream work stalls (lines 208, 237, 259, 275, 284, 310). The consumer has capacity — it's stuck on one message. Dead-letter msg-416639 and add a retry limit. Red herrings: line 129 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); line 71 (a routine disk usage warning on the log volume, nowhere near full); line 125 (a single long GC pause in a healthy service, with heap well below limits).
